//: Merge these into ~/.claude/settings.json to enable hooks/claude/session-scratchpad.sh. The permissions.allow rules grant the hook's scratchpad store (kept outside any repo) read/write access; the SessionStart hook creates/loads the per-project, per-session scratchpad; the PreCompact hook preserves the path and task state across compaction. NOTE: also merge hooks/claude/CLAUDE.snippet.md into your global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md — it is the durable ingest half that survives compaction.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreCompact","customInstructions":"Preserve verbatim: the scratchpad path under ~/.claude-session-scratchpads/, the current task, completed steps, and pending steps."}}'
